verdicts.quote: Two runs for the same day that overlap (duplicate trigger, two instances) send each step at most once in total. A run that dies part-way is completed by the next trigger without repeating finished work

immediately before handing a reminder to the mail provider, the system re-reads the invoice and the account switch; if the invoice is no longer remindable (paid in full, voided, balance 0) ... nothing is sent
